prompt: Photorealistic side-profile product shot of a stair-climbing hand truck paused mid-climb on a concrete residential stair flight, no text or labels. Two three-wheeled tri-star clusters with 150mm solid black rubber wheels on steel tri-arms contact two adjacent stair noses. Central steel worm gearbox housing mounted visibly on the cluster axle between the frames, with small pawl block and short hand crank. Twin parallel brushed aluminium spine tubes run diagonally parallel to the stair slope, L-shaped. At the lower end a hinged aluminium toe plate sticks out horizontally carrying a large brown cardboard parcel strapped vertically against the spine with black polyester webbing. At the upper end a telescopic closed-loop aluminium handle with steel dead-man lever. Real materials: brushed aluminium, dark steel, matte black rubber, plywood-like toe, corrugated cardboard. Soft daylight product lighting, sharp focus on mechanism, shallow depth of field, residential stairwell context, operating tilt, all six wheels, both clusters, gearbox, spine, toe, parcel and handle clearly visible and correctly connected.
changes_from_previous: Initial version, no prior image to revise.

visual_plan.view: true side elevation, camera perpendicular to stair flight, full device and two steps visible
visual_plan.spatial_layout: Side view perpendicular to stair flight. Stair flight diagonals from lower left to upper right with 170mm riser 280mm tread profile. Cluster centered on stair noses in middle ground. Spine diagonal above cluster parallel to slope. Toe and parcel low-forward over steps. Handle high to upper right. Fixed stair below, moving cluster mid-rotation, fixed spine and toe relative to each other during hold.
visual_plan.operating_moment: Paused mid-step ascent with load aboard: one wheel of each tri-star on lower tread nose and one on upper nose, parcel strapped on toe, spine reclined ~30 deg, worm holding position without hand grip, showing lift of one riser.
visual_plan.transfer_path: Hand pull at closed-loop handle into spine and via crank into self-locking worm to tri-star axle to stair nose reaction lifting toe and parcel one step.
visual_plan.interactions: Wheels roll on stair noses, tri-arms pivot about central axle, worm gearbox locks axle to spine, spine carries parcel weight to axle, toe hinge supports parcel from below with straps clamping parcel to spine, handle loop transmits pull into spine and crank into worm.
avoid: showing wrong wheel count per cluster
